subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 5: Culture – Nature reserves in Oman
outcomes: Describe three nature reserves in Oman.
Choose a reserve to visit and give a reason.
Make a leaflet about a nature reserve.

tf.s: The Arabian leopard lives in Jabal Samhan.
You can visit the Daymaniyat Islands from May to October.
tf.why: You can't, because turtles lay their eggs on the beaches.

tf.s: The world's largest nature reserve is in Oman.
At Khawr Ruri you can see the ruins of the old city of Samharam.
tf.why: Well done! The ruins are very old.

tf.s: Jabal Samhan is a nature reserve in Oman.
tf.why: Yes! It's one of the reserves in the lesson.

tf.s: Turtles lay their eggs on the beaches of the Daymaniyat Islands.
tf.why: Great! That's why visitors can't go in those months.

tf.s: Samharam is a kind of turtle.
tf.why: Samharam is an old city. You can see its ruins at Khawr Ruri.

tf.s: A good leaflet has a title, photos and short information.
tf.why: Yes! These are the parts of a leaflet.

tf.s: The Arabian leopard is a very common animal.
tf.why: It is one of the rarest animals.

boxes.why: They are in the sea near Muscat.

boxes.q: What can you do at a nature reserve?
Which question asks what is in the reserve?
boxes.why: 'What can you see there?' asks about animals and places.

boxes.q: What can tourists see at Khawr Ruri?
boxes.why: Khawr Ruri has the ruins of Samharam.

boxes.q: Complete: I want to visit Jabal Samhan ___ I want to see the leopard.
Which question asks about the place of a reserve?

boxes.why: Ruins are what is left of old buildings.

boxes.q: Complete the leaflet: The ... ___ Reserve is in ... .
How do you write the title of a leaflet?

mcq.q: Which three reserves are in the lesson?
o: Daymaniyat Islands, Jabal Samhan, Khawr Ruri
mcq.why: These are three nature reserves in Oman.

mcq.q: When can't you visit the Daymaniyat Islands?
mcq.why: Visitors can't go from May to October.

o: a place where animals and plants are protected

mcq.q: Which animals lay eggs on the Daymaniyat beaches?
Sara loves sea animals. Which reserve is best for her?
mcq.why: The Daymaniyat Islands are a marine reserve.

mcq.q: Omar likes old history. Which place should he visit?
mcq.why: Khawr Ruri has the ruins of an old city.

mcq.q: Choose a superlative sentence for a leaflet.
o: The Arabian leopard is one of the rarest animals.
The Arabian leopard is rare than a cat.
The Arabian leopard is the most rare.

mcq.q: Why can't visitors go to the Daymaniyat Islands from May to October?
o: Because turtles lay their eggs on the beaches.
Because the islands are closed for school.
mcq.why: People stay away to protect the turtles' eggs.

o: I want to visit Jabal Samhan because I want to see the leopard.
It has a title, photos and short sentences.
It has very long sentences and no photos.
mcq.why: A clear leaflet has a title, photos and short information.
